_comment: Per-site ordering recipes. Everything that made the Swiggy order work was hardcoded inside
orderUsualInOrder — the search URL, the test for 'am I on a menu page', the cart selector, the
labels on the dialog buttons. That meant it worked for exactly one restaurant on exactly one
site: 'order burgers from burger king' went to the old guessing path and got nothing.
Adding a site is now data, not code. The behaviour that took a day to get right — search by URL
rather than a suggestion, two ADD controls per row where only one works, count the basket instead
of believing the click, answer a customisation dialog from stored choices — is shared by all of
cartRe   : matches the cart badge text, capturing the item count.
menuRe   : matches the URL path of a restaurant/product page (proof we actually got there).
searchUrl: {q} is replaced with the url-encoded query.
dishSearch: label of the in-page control that opens the per-dish search, if the site has one.
dialog   : labels used to complete an options dialog, in order.
